from collections import defaultdict
def boxinfo(g):
    pts=defaultdict(list)
    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        for j,v in enumerate(r):
            if v: pts[v].append((i,j))
    return pts
def interior_pattern(g,v):
    ps=boxinfo(g)[v]
    i0=min(p[0] for p in ps); j0=min(p[1] for p in ps)
    i1=max(p[0] for p in ps); j1=max(p[1] for p in ps)
    S=set(ps)
    return {(i-i0-1,j-j0-1) for i in range(i0+1,i1) for j in range(j0+1,j1) if (i,j) in S}
def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    pts=boxinfo(g)
    pat={v:interior_pattern(g,v) for v in pts if interior_pattern(g,v)}
    src=next(iter(pat)); IP=pat[src]
    ps=pts[src]
    i0=min(p[0] for p in ps); j0=min(p[1] for p in ps)
    i1=max(p[0] for p in ps); j1=max(p[1] for p in ps)
    bh,bw=i1-i0+1,j1-j0+1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for v,ps in pts.items():
        a0=min(p[0] for p in ps); b0=min(p[1] for p in ps)
        a1=max(p[0] for p in ps); b1=max(p[1] for p in ps)
        if (a1-a0+1,b1-b0+1)!=(bh,bw):
            for i,j in ps: out[i][j]=0
        elif v!=src:
            for di,dj in IP: out[a0+1+di][b0+1+dj]=v
    return out
'''
